entities.summary: Makhmud Sabyrkhan is a Kazakh boxer. He competed at the 2021 AIBA World Boxing Championships, winning the silver medal in the bantamweight event. He also competed at the 2023 IBA World Boxing Championships, winning the gold medal in the same event.
